[SWS_DM_01319] Consecutive registration of notifier with Release- Handler::SetNotifier()
⌈
In case of a consecutive call of ara::diag::Release-
Handler::SetNotifier of the corresponding ara::diag::ReleaseHandler in-
stance, the DM shall overwrite the previous registered notifier.
⌋
